children: South Korean retail investors net bought about $4.8 billion in U.S. stocks from October 1 to 22, including $3.548 billion in the Direxion Daily Semiconductor Bull 3X Shares ETF (SOXL), or 73.9% of their net purchases, according to Korea Securities Depository data. According to Odaily, the KOSPI fell 18.83% this month. From October 1 to 23, retail investors net bought 315.4 billion won in single-stock leveraged products tied to Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix, marking their first monthly net purchases since regulatory restrictions tightened at the end of July.

title: South Korean Retail Investors Net Buy $3.548 Billion in SOXL Since October
